payload.goal: Find the overdue customer invoice, add reminder fee accounting of 70 NOK, create and send a reminder-fee invoice to the same customer, and register a partial payment of 5000 NOK on the overdue invoice.
success_checks: An overdue customer invoice is identified.
A voucher is posted with debit account 1500 and credit account 3400 for 70 NOK.
A new customer invoice for reminder fee 70 NOK is created for the same customer.
A payment of 5000 NOK is registered against the overdue invoice.
Outstanding balance on the overdue invoice is reduced by 5000 NOK.
risk_notes: No customer name or invoice number provided; must search for overdue invoices and choose the intended one.
Sandbox is empty, so there may be no existing overdue invoice despite the prompt implying one exists.
VAT for reminder fee is not specified; keep VAT uncertain/null unless local rules or product defaults are known.
Bank account/payment method details are not provided; payment registration may require a bank account or payment type.
If multiple overdue invoices exist, selection criteria are ambiguous.
Reminder fee may alternatively be added directly to existing invoice in some workflows, but prompt also explicitly asks to create a separate invoice.
payload.suggested_first_action: List/search customer invoices and filter for overdue unpaid invoices to identify the target invoice and customer.
ordered_steps: GET /invoice?status=OPEN and filter overdue by dueDate < today to identify the overdue invoice
If sandbox has no data: create bootstrap customer via POST /customer
If sandbox has no data: create bootstrap order via POST /order for that customer
If sandbox has no data: add order line(s) via POST /order/{id}/orderline and create/send an invoice via POST /invoice from order so an overdue invoice exists
Ensure ledger accounts 1500 and 3400 are available in chart of accounts
POST /voucher with one entry debiting 1500 by 70 NOK and one entry crediting 3400 by 70 NOK, linked to the customer if supported
Optionally create/find a product for reminder fee via POST /product with price 70 NOK and unspecified VAT
POST /order for the same customer for the reminder fee invoice
POST /order/{id}/orderline with description 'Frais de rappel', quantity 1, unit price 70 NOK
Send the reminder-fee invoice via invoice send endpoint/email dispatch
Register partial payment of 5000 NOK on the overdue invoice via POST /payment or invoice payment endpoint
Verify overdue invoice residual amount decreased and reminder-fee invoice status is sent

planned_endpoints.summary: Find invoices corresponding with sent data. Includes charged outgoing invoices only.
Create customer. Related customer addresses may also be created.
Create invoice. Related Order and OrderLines can be created first, or included as new objects inside the Invoice.

rules: When email is provided, ALWAYS set BOTH email AND invoiceEmail to the same value.
Do NOT send isCustomer (it's readOnly and auto-set).
For addresses, use postalAddress={addressLine1, postalCode, city, country={id: 161}} for Norway.
Set orderDate and deliveryDate (use today_iso from execution_brief).
ALWAYS search first if product_number is provided: GET /product?number=<number> — sandbox pre-seeds products.
Only POST /product if GET returns 0 results.
Use 'number' field for the product number (NOT productNumber).
priceExcludingVat sets the base price. Also set vatType={"id": 3|5|6}.
Pass orders=[{"id": order_id}] to link order.
Bank account 1920 MUST be configured first (see bank account setup pattern).

payload.headline: Half the checks failed: voucher postings and payment likely misconfigured despite apparent success
what_went_wrong: Checks 4-6 failed despite API returning 200 OK — likely the voucher postings had wrong debit/credit sign convention or missing currency.factor field (first attempt got 422 for missing factor).

The voucher posting structure may have been incorrect: Tripletex expects debit as positive on account 1500 and credit as negative on 3400, but the currency object lacked 'factor' field causing initial failure and possibly residual issues.

PUT /invoice/:payment call succeeded but checks 5-6 failed — the payment body likely used wrong paymentTypeId or missing required fields (amount, paymentDate), causing the payment to not register correctly.
Two duplicate GET /product calls and two duplicate GET /ledger/account calls were made unnecessarily, adding waste without value.
what_worked: Customer creation, order creation, invoice creation and sending all succeeded correctly (checks 1-3 passed).
Recovered from the 422 currency.factor error by fetching correct account IDs and retrying the voucher.
what_to_try_next: Fix voucher postings: include 'currency': {'id': 1, 'code': 'NOK', 'factor': 1} in each posting, and verify debit row has positive amountGross on account 1500 and credit row has negative on account 3400.

For PUT /invoice/:payment, explicitly pass body with paymentTypeId, amount=5000, paymentDate, and verify the correct payment type ID is used — fetch GET /invoice/paymentType first and confirm the ID maps to a bank payment.
Eliminate duplicate GET /product and GET /ledger/account calls; cache results from first call to reduce total API calls from 19 to ~15.
unnecessary_calls: Second GET /product call (duplicate of first, no new data needed)
Second GET /ledger/account call (duplicate — both account 1500 and 3400 could be fetched in one call with filtering)
PUT /ledger/account/474548438 to set bank account — not required by the task and adds an unnecessary write operation
